text_to_speech: how to start fire with flint and steel this is your Flint or CH this is your steel not stainless and this is your char cloth and this case it's paper towel easiest way to do it and if you need more information please click the link below because I cannot fit everything you need to know in this one video take your CH cloth hold it with your thumb up against a sharp edge of your flint and strike the steel down towards it once you notice you've got an ember blow on it just to get it a stab Lish I like to hold it together with finger and I take that flint and I put it into a Tinder bundle and char cloth and I put this all together you can stick a whole bunch of stuff in there including gyant and you hold this all together I put my kindling right there with it and I blow and there's your fire
